meta.title: A Flag for the Book Fair

paragraphs: My name is Lily, and I am ten years old. Our class had a book fair on Saturday. Mia and I made a flag for the entrance of our room. "Everyone must see the flag before they enter," said Teacher Kim. Here is how we made it. It is not hard. You need a computer, paper, glue, scissors, and a long stick. Dad gave us a stick from the garden. "Carry the stick in your hands, not on your shoulder," he said.

Step one: Look at the screen and open the drawing page. Step two: Draw a big open book. Step three: Write "BOOK FAIR" above the book. Step four: Make the book green and the words yellow. "Can we add Pip?" asked Mia. "Yes, Pip can read a book too," I said. We drew a small brown puppy on the book.

Step five: Save the picture with a name. "Save it as flag, so we find it again," said Mia. Step six: Print the picture on paper. Step seven: Cut out the picture. Step eight: Glue one side on the stick. Ask an adult to help with the scissors. Do not hurry. Dad helped us, and the flag was ready in an hour.

On Saturday, we put the flag at the entrance. Mia held the stick in both hands. The green flag moved in the wind near the door. Many children saw it and came into the room. "Is that Pip on the flag?" asked a boy. "Yes, he loves books," said Mia. Teacher Kim smiled and said, "A good flag, girls." We were very happy, and we were proud of our work.
